lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: Welcome to the IT Workshop! I'm Joko, the most senior technician here. Just call me Pak Joko.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: Your job: read help tickets and diagnostic reports, mark the evidence, then decide.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: GUIDE USER if the device is healthy and they just need to be shown how. FIX if something is wrong but can be sorted out.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: If it needs special access or expertise, ESCALATE. Confused? Open the Workshop Handbook.

lines.speaker: joko
lines.text: First day done. Remember, half of all complaints are solved just by checking the simple things.
